verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
We remember how You loved us
To your death

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
And still we celebrate
For You are with us here

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
We believe that we will see you
When you come
In your glory Lord

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
We remember
We celebrate
We believe

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Here a million wounded souls
Are yearning just to touch you and be healed

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Gather all your people
And hold them to your heart

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Now we recreate your love
We bring the bread and wine to share a meal

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Sign of grace and mercy
The presence of the Lord

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Christ, the Father's great "Amen"
To all the hopes and dreams of every heart

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Peace beyond all telling
Freedom from all fear
